> **Roadmap update, 2026-10-23:** Master has decided to remove the Tauri client and build the TUI from scratch. Current implementation follows the [TUI requirements](../../tui/requirements-and-backend-plan.md) and [overall roadmap #57](https://github.com/ExplodeCode6324/Secretary/issues/57). See [#79](https://github.com/ExplodeCode6324/Secretary/issues/79) for removal of the old client. The material below records the frozen former roadmap; it no longer guides new feature implementation, and remaining acceptance work for the old GUI does not block the TUI.

Version: FE-DOC R1, 2026-10-21. Master approved the R1 plan and design decisions; this document set awaits final review. #62 starts only after #61 is merged and explicitly confirmed by Master.

This is the repository’s single current frontend specification entry; all language editions describe the same specification. Frozen v1.0 is the sole authoritative visual source: **when uncertain, consult v1.0 and follow it first; revise later as Master directs.**

[v1.0 · UI-DESIGN.md](https://github.com/ExplodeCode6324/secretary-phase-ui-design/blob/8cdb9219bed9493147ba10f7d47423df56cbcc44/UI-DESIGN.md) · [v1.0.0 · source](https://github.com/ExplodeCode6324/secretary-phase-ui-design/tree/8cdb9219bed9493147ba10f7d47423df56cbcc44)

- [Architecture and flows](architecture-and-flows.md): desktop, bridge, Core and capability boundaries.
- [PhaseUI design](phaseui-design.md): colors, layout, typography and motion sources.
- [Components and states](components-and-states.md): structure, three frames, cancellation and input.
- [Acceptance](acceptance.md): current evidence, future native checks and performance evaluation.
- [Source migration](source-migration.md): historical clauses, capability mapping and R1 decisions.

The implementation baseline is `5f73c23` (FE-02 / PR #75), with the minimum real workflow. Full visual components belong to #62; conversation, tasks, memory/settings and artifacts/notifications belong to #63–#66 respectively. Current desktop acceptance targets macOS. Linux is deferred / NOT_TESTED and is not a roadmap gate; Core Linux CI is unchanged.

#61 consolidates documentation only. Master withdrew the deployment request: no deployment or early #62 implementation is included. See [desktop instructions](../desktop/README.md) for running it and the [historical index](../../old/README.md) for past material.

## PhaseUI implementation candidate (#62)

The production component mapping and explicit adaptations are recorded in the [component contract](../../../src/secretary_desktop/src/phaseui/README.md) and [implementation evidence](../../fix/evidence/issue62-phaseui/summary.md). The frozen design remains the authority; candidate evidence does not replace Master acceptance. Resource comparison uses [the PhaseUI harness](../../../src/secretary_desktop/scripts/phaseui_measure.py), separately from the historical FE-00 measurements.
